title: Unique ordinary total-tensor evaluation for the actual coefficient sequence
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, and a scheme $W$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension, def-pc-scheme]. Use the actual commutative coefficient sequence and its evaluation functor $e_n$ [def-coef-ringed-sequence-site], with the total tensor of [def-coef-ringed-tensor-hom-model]. For every level $n$, use the canonical section transport given by $\operatorname{eqToHom}$ of the recorded equality between the abelian section objects of the evaluation and the original level. For arbitrary unbounded cochain complexes $P,Q$ of actual coefficient systems there is a unique isomorphism $e_n(\operatorname{Tot}(P\otimes Q))\cong\operatorname{Tot}(e_nP\otimes e_nQ)$ carrying every pure total generator in bidegree $(p,q)$, $p+q=k$, to the corresponding generator formed from the transported sections. No K-flatness, boundedness, or normalization hypothesis is imposed.

Agent-formulated ordinary total-complex consequence of these constructions; no derived or flatness assertion is needed.

proof.text: The actual coefficient sequence evaluation equals the generic semilinear evaluation functor by unfolding their definitions; the ringed sequence sheaves and structural identity maps agree. Record the actual functor zero-morphism preservation separately.

Apply the unique pure-generator-normalized total-tensor evaluation theorem to that functor, its equality with semilinear evaluation, the supplied section transport, and P,Q. The source ring and total tensors agree definitionally with the actual coefficient constructions, so its isomorphism, generator formula, and uniqueness give precisely the assertion.

Specialize the general section-transport assertion to this actual eqToHom transport. Equality elimination shows that applying eqToHom to a section is heterogeneously equal to the original section. The general isomorphism, generator formula and uniqueness therefore give the canonical coefficient comparison.

theorem coefficientTotalTensorEvaluation_existsUnique (n : ℕ)
    (P Q : CochainComplex (coefficientSequenceModules l E W) ℤ) :
    ∃! e : ((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E W n).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
          ((coefficientTotalTensor.{u, t+1, t}
            (coefficientSequenceTopology (Scheme.ProEt.topology W))
            (coefficientSequenceCommRingSheaf l E W)).obj (P, Q)) ≅
      (coefficientTotalTensor.{u, t+1, t} (Scheme.ProEt.topology W)
        (integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E W n)).obj
          (((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E W n).mapHomologicalComplex
            (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj P,
           ((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E W n).mapHomologicalComplex
            (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj Q),
      ∀ (p q k : ℤ) (h : p + q = k) (U : W.ProEtᵒᵖ)
        (x : (P.X p).val.obj (op (n, U.unop)))
        (y : (Q.X q).val.obj (op (n, U.unop))),
      (e.hom.f k).val.app U
        ((eqToHom (coefficientSequenceEvaluationAb_eq l E W _ n U).symm)
          (coefficientTensorGenerator.{u, t+1, t}
            (coefficientSequenceTopology (Scheme.ProEt.topology W))
            (coefficientSequenceCommRingSheaf l E W) P Q p q k h
            (op (n, U.unop)) x y)) =
        coefficientTensorGenerator.{u, t+1, t} (Scheme.ProEt.topology W)
          (integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E W n)
          (((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E W n).mapHomologicalComplex
            (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj P)
          (((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E W n).mapHomologicalComplex
            (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj Q) p q k h U
          ((eqToHom (coefficientSequenceEvaluationAb_eq l E W (P.X p) n U).symm) x)
          ((eqToHom (coefficientSequenceEvaluationAb_eq l E W (Q.X q) n U).symm) y)
